name: Extreme heat
summary: Bureau of Meteorology severe heatwave warning for Queensland's Gulf Country and Peninsula on 11 Nov
state: The Bureau of Meteorology's Queensland heatwave warning issued on 11 Nov forecast severe heatwave conditions in the Gulf Country and Peninsula, intensifying towards the end of the week, with maximums in the high 30s to low 40s°C (WillyWeather, citing BoM). Mozambique's meteorology institute warned of heat up to 43°C in Manica and Tete provinces until 8 Nov (Club of Mozambique). This meets the regional-warning line for Watch; no deadly heatwave under top-tier warnings over a large population was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Mainly affects residents and outdoor workers in northern Australia and southern Africa. Travellers to affected areas should follow local met service warnings and FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Heatwave warnings across a major region (BoM severe heatwave, northern Queensland) = Watch; no top-tier deadly heatwave for Alert

sources.title: WillyWeather — Heatwave warning for Gulf Country and Peninsula (Bureau of Meteorology)
Club of Mozambique — INAM warns heatwave to continue in Manica and Tete provinces

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
